title: Frontend: Points display and level badge component with points history tooltip
description: Create the points display widget that shows current points, level, and on hover shows recent points transactions.
acceptanceCriteria: Shows level badge (e.g., 'Sprout') with an icon
Hover tooltip shows last 5 points transactions from points_log
Points and level update reactively when actions are taken
Level badge color changes per level

steps.details: Create src/components/project/PointsDisplay.tsx. Shows level badge (Star icon + level name) and points count. Use shadcn/ui Tooltip to show recent points log on hover.
Add GET /api/projects/:id/points-log endpoint (add to server — query last 5 points_log entries ORDER BY created_at DESC). Display in tooltip: each row shows delta (green/red), reason, time ago.
Seed=gray, Sprout=green, Growing=blue, Shipping=orange, Launched=purple. Apply as Tailwind classes based on level string.
Complete a todo — verify points increment in real time. Hover over points — verify log shows recent transactions.
